text.title: Product-Led Growth (PLG) Failure Modes
text.summary: 11 antipatterns observed across deployments. Each pairs symptom + root-cause + concrete fix. Hard rules for agent-safe PLG work, limitations of PLG in specific contexts, and AI-agent failure modes with mitigations. The hard rules themselves live in 01-core-rules.xml.

antipattern.symptom: Activation rate <15%; first-session funnel exits before aha event.
antipattern.root-cause: Onboarding flow takes 9+ minutes to first value.
antipattern.fix: Re-design onboarding for aha < 5 min; cut steps, defer profile completion.

antipattern.symptom: Sales gets PQL handoffs that haven't logged in for 3 weeks.
antipattern.root-cause: PQL score uses email-engagement signals; no usage signals.
antipattern.fix: templates/pql-scorer.py MUST score on real usage (workspaces, integrations, invited collaborators, depth events).

antipattern.symptom: Self-serve conversion stuck; users hit 'book a call' wall to upgrade.
antipattern.root-cause: Pricing page gates paid tier behind sales call.
antipattern.fix: Remove the sales-required gate; offer sales-assist as opt-in path for enterprise.

antipattern.symptom: Upgrade emails sent on day 7 / 14 / 21 regardless of usage; reply: 'unsubscribe'.
antipattern.root-cause: Triggers based on calendar, not on hitting usage limits.
antipattern.fix: Fire upgrade prompts on limit-hit events only; deprecate calendar campaigns for PLG accounts.

antipattern.symptom: Running PLG optimization on a pre-PMF product with insufficient retention signal.
antipattern.root-cause: PLG amplifies a working loop; on a broken product it industrialises churn. Establish product-market fit before instrumenting the PLG funnel.
antipattern.fix: Apply rule skip-this-methodology until retention signal exists.

antipattern.symptom: AI onboarding personalization attempting to reference user behavior data before any events have been captured (cold start in first 60 seconds).
antipattern.root-cause: Enforce a "no behavioural reference before event N" rule. Cold-start personalization that references unavailable data produces error messages or hallucinated user attributes.
antipattern.fix: Gate personalization on a minimum captured-event count.

antipattern.symptom: Privacy regimes (GDPR, India DPDP) restricting event tracking that PLG analytics depend on, with consent-mode gaps distorting funnels.
antipattern.root-cause: Instrument consent-mode handling before running PLG analytics. Funnels measured without accounting for consent gaps systematically under-count users in regulated markets.

antipattern.symptom: Agents over-fitting on small samples: calling a winner with fewer than 1k users per variant or fewer than 7 days of runtime.
antipattern.root-cause: Enforce the minimum exposure and runtime gates at the agent output layer, not just in the prompt. Agents will call winners on day 2 with 200 users per variant if not blocked.
antipattern.fix: Apply rule srm-and-mde-gate-per-experiment as a hard output gate.

antipattern.symptom: LLMs inventing metrics ("engagement score 0-100") that have no source event in the analytics schema.
antipattern.root-cause: Constrain output to a known event vocabulary loaded from the analytics schema. Invented metrics cannot be tracked or validated.
antipattern.fix: Load the event vocabulary into the prompt and reject any metric outside it.

antipattern.symptom: Tour-builder agents adding steps rather than removing them, even when prompted to optimize onboarding.
antipattern.root-cause: Prompt explicitly with "subtract first" and a step-count budget. Monitor step-count delta as a guardrail metric alongside activation rate.

antipattern.symptom: PQL scoring drift: static model becomes wrong as the product evolves but continues to be used without recalibration.
antipattern.root-cause: Schedule quarterly PQL model recalibration as a standing SDD task. Flag if the model has not been recalibrated in 90+ days.
